plugins.name: atc-audio
plugins.description: Find, download, transcribe and analyze archived air traffic control radio (LiveATC), with silence removal and UTC-correct timestamps for lining transmissions up with ADS-B tracks

plugins.name: satellite-imagery
plugins.description: Find aircraft, ships and radio transmitters in Sentinel-2 optical, Sentinel-1 radar and NISAR L-band radar imagery: per-pixel imaging times, matching colour-fringed aircraft streaks to ADS-B tracks, ship detection with fixed-object and ghost flags, parked aircraft in NISAR HH/HV, and locating interference sources (GPS jammers, L- and C-band radars) from SAR, including NISAR's RFI filter record
